top_choice_rationale: Car-Parrinello molecular dynamics (1985) is a mature, independently reproduced method that removed the need for pre-fitted force fields and opened bond breaking, solvation and condensed-phase reactivity to first-principles treatment across catalysis, water, battery and materials chemistry. The credit is a clean two-author paper with no allocation dispute raised, and the citation can be held to the 1985 idea. P001 (Pd-catalysed C-N coupling, Hartwig and Buchwald) is a close second with broader committee support; the protein-degradation proposals follow because attribution remains contested and no PROTAC is yet approved.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile; Lund physics background is adjacent to the method but no personal connection to Car or Parrinello is documented
